podcast.title: Guest Guitar on Crossover Hit (1986)
podcast.body: Joe Perry provided guest guitar on Run-DMC's 1986 cover of "Walk This Way," contributing to rap's first big pop crossover hit and showcasing a significant collaboration between rock and hip hop artists. "featuring guest vocals and guitar from Aerosmith's own Steven Tyler and Joe Perry"

podcast.title: Funk Influence on Guitar Riff
podcast.body: As the guitarist for Aerosmith, Joe Perry patterned the highly syncopated beat and riff of "Walk This Way" after The Meters, contributing to the song's white rock approximation of funk. "guitarist Joe Perry patterned after the meters."
